result.answer: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09 requires temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement [E1]. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required, with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. Additionally, specific actions are required based on hepatic laboratory results: if ALT/AST is >3x ULN, medical review is required; if Bilirubin is >2x ULN, urgent review is required; and for a mild isolated change below trigger, a repeat test is required [E2].
